stepNotes.1: Single-file unit (packages/ax-code/src/patch/index.ts, 786 LOC); MODULE-AUDIT's 1/787 tally matches. Two parallel apply surfaces identified: verified vs legacy Patch.applyHunksToFiles.
stepNotes.2: Filesystem.contains is lexical and explicitly does not resolve symlinks (util/filesystem.ts:209-210); the in-module applyHunksToFiles path never realpath()s and skips assertSymlinkInsideProject, unlike the tool layer at apply_patch.ts:90.
stepNotes.3: applyReplacements (index.ts:440-457) has no overlap check; native seekSequence (index.ts:502-539) returns -1 without falling back through the four JS fuzzy passes, so behaviour diverges across native/JS builds.
stepNotes.4: deriveNewContentsFromChunks uses synchronous readFileSync (index.ts:351) from two async call sites, stalling the event loop on large files; JS fallback of generateUnifiedDiff allocates O(n*m) Int32Array at index.ts:558.
stepNotes.5: Patch.applyPatch/applyHunksToFiles are exported as public API but called only from tests (patch.test.ts:198-437); production tool layer reimplements writes with FileTime locks, conflict re-read, and rollback that the in-module path omits.
stepNotes.6: Dead surface: ApplyPatchArgs.workdir (index.ts:25) plus MaybeApplyPatch.ShellParseError and MaybeApplyPatchVerified.ShellParseError (index.ts:66,73) have zero producers; ApplyPatchAction/ApplyPatchFileChange types are produced only by the unused maybeParseApplyPatchVerified path.
stepNotes.7: patch.test.ts covers parser/CRLF/move/blank-line cases but has no assertion for Unicode-normalisation pass (index.ts:531-537), EOF anchor matching (index.ts:472-484), replacement overlap, or native-vs-JS divergence; tool/apply_patch.test.ts covers the production write path instead.
stepNotes.8: Eight findings filed (3 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 1 LOW); no Critical, so the independent-verify gate is not triggered for this unit and reverify.md is not required by the conditional in the task brief.
stepNotes.9: Read-only reviewer did not execute typecheck/tests; evidence is from direct reads of the three source/test files. Recommended follow-up order: fate of applyHunksToFiles/applyPatch, overlap assertion, native/JS seekSequence reconciliation, harvest dead enum variants.
